say:2:1510313001:0.text: I can't believe you came to Mirehold alone, Gala! Where are Modra and Kordan?
say:2:1510313001:0.source_cn: 加拉，你竟然一个人来水泽营地！蒙多和戈丹呢？

say:3:1510313002:0.text: You furless apes have captured Gala, haven't you? She's a sacred offering to the Hunting God! Keep your filthy paws off her!
say:3:1510313002:0.source_cn: ……你们，人类。你们把加拉也抓来了？她是献给狩猎神的宝...
say:3:1510313002:0.male: You furless apes have captured Gala, haven't you? She's a sacred offering to the Hunting God! Keep your filthy paws off her!
say:3:1510313002:0.female: You furless apes have captured Gala, haven't you? She's a sacred offering to the Hunting Goddess! Keep your filthy paws off her!

say:4:1510313003:0.text: No, Halftail. The Hunting God has descended. I am no longer a sacrifice.
say:4:1510313003:0.source_cn: 不。狩猎神大人降临，加拉不是祭品了。

say:4:1510313003:0.female: No, Halftail. The Hunting Goddess has descended. I am no longer a sacrifice.

say:7:1510313005:0.text: The Hunting God has come to free us himself! All hail the Herdmaster!
say:7:1510313005:0.source_cn: ……兽群之主来亲自释放我们了！至强狩猎神！
say:7:1510313005:0.male: The Hunting God has come to free us himself! All hail the Herdmaster!
say:7:1510313005:0.female: The Hunting Goddess has come to free us herself! All hail the Herdmaster!

say:8:1510313006:0.text: Are the humans treating you badly? The Herdmaster will punish them.
say:8:1510313006:0.source_cn: 人，对你们坏吗？狩猎神会惩罚他们。
say:8:1510313006:0.male: Are the humans treating you badly? The Herdmaster will punish them.
say:8:1510313006:0.female: Are the humans treating you badly? The Herdmaster will punish them.

say:9:1510313007:0.text: The Halians are terrible and very strange!
say:9:1510313007:0.source_cn: 哦，呼临人很坏！他们很奇怪！

say:10:1510313008:1.text: They're not whipping us or sacrificing us... Instead, they've got us doing something called "farming"...
say:10:1510313008:1.source_cn: 不鞭打我们，也不献祭我们，而是让我们做……做什么“耕种”。

choice_prompt:11:1510313008.text: They're not whipping us or sacrificing us... Instead, they've got us doing something called "farming"...
choice_prompt:11:1510313008.source_cn: 不鞭打我们，也不献祭我们，而是让我们做……做什么“耕种”。

say:12:1510313009:0.text: I don't understand! There's nothing in the ground. We end up hunting and foraging anyway.
say:12:1510313009:0.source_cn: 不明白！地里什么也没有，所以我们还是狩猎和采集。

say:13:1510313010:0.text: The Halians would take some of the food we brought back. But they didn't even help! They're terrible people.
say:13:1510313010:0.source_cn: 带回的食物，呼临人会拿走一部分。但他们明明没出力！所以...

say:15:1510313012:0.text: We're fine, but the Halians are always watching us. We can't escape.
say:15:1510313012:0.source_cn: 还好！但呼临人一直看着，没法跑。
